subject.title: fix(line): await deferred ingress release on stop

question: Does the LINE lifecycle guarantee that every deferred claim signals adoption or abandonment, making an unbounded settlement wait acceptable during stop?
rationale: The patch correctly prevents early recovery and duplicate dispatch, but CI alone cannot prove that every production shutdown path invokes a terminal lifecycle callback; missing one would stall LINE shutdown.

options.title: Accept the settlement invariant
options.body: Land after exact-head checks if owners confirm every deferred LINE lifecycle reaches adoption or abandonment; this preserves single-owner durable delivery.

options.title: Define a bounded stop contract
options.body: Pause and design a bounded shutdown policy if terminal lifecycle settlement cannot be guaranteed without reintroducing recovery of a still-owned claim.

recommendation.title: Accept the settlement invariant
recommendation.body: Land after exact-head checks if owners confirm every deferred LINE lifecycle reaches adoption or abandonment; this preserves single-owner durable delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the assigned owner and authored the coordinated core and LINE lifecycle change.
